title: Enable MSI Mode for GPU
name: enable-msi-mode-gpu
description: Switches GPU to Message-Signaled Interrupts for lower latency and better FPS stability.
deepDescription: Enables Message-Signaled Interrupts (MSI) mode for the GPU by setting the MSISupported registry key. MSI mode reduces interrupt latency compared to Line-Based interrupts, resulting in more stable frame times and reduced input lag in games. Requires reboot to take effect.
